# Comparisons ("Comparisons and ordering"): the quiet predicates compare
# values, TotalOrder compares values then exponents and NaNs by sign bit
# alone, and Key is the hash key of a value. None rounds, so the classes
# are exact, underflow (subnormal operands), zero, inf, nan and noncanon.
# A Key result is coeff exp kind neg.

# --- Equal64 ---

Equal64 - exact 1.0 1.00 -> true
Equal64 - exact 1 1.000000000000001 -> false
Equal64 - exact 1E+2 100 -> true
Equal64 - exact 1.5E+3 1500 -> true
Equal64 - exact 9.999999999999999E+384 9.999999999999999E+384 -> true
Equal64 - exact -1 1 -> false
Equal64 - exact 123.456 123.456 -> true
Equal64 - exact 1E+369 1.0E+370 -> false
Equal64 - exact 1.0E+370 1.0E+370 -> true

Equal64 - underflow 1E-398 1E-398 -> true
Equal64 - underflow 1E-398 2E-398 -> false
Equal64 - underflow 1E-398 0 -> false
Equal64 - underflow 1E-383 1.000000000000000E-383 -> true

Equal64 - zero 0 -0 -> true
Equal64 - zero 0E+369 -0E-398 -> true
Equal64 - zero 0 0.00 -> true
Equal64 - zero 0 1E-398 -> false
Equal64 - zero -0 -0.0 -> true

Equal64 - inf Infinity Infinity -> true
Equal64 - inf Infinity -Infinity -> false
Equal64 - inf Infinity 9.999999999999999E+384 -> false
Equal64 - inf -Infinity -Infinity -> true

Equal64 - nan NaN NaN -> false
Equal64 - nan sNaN sNaN -> false
Equal64 - nan NaN 1 -> false
Equal64 - nan 1 NaN -> false
Equal64 - nan NaN Infinity -> false
Equal64 - nan -NaN -NaN -> false
Equal64 - nan 0x7c00000000000001 0x7c00000000000001 -> false

Equal64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff 0 -> true
Equal64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff -0 -> true
Equal64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff 0x6c77ffffffffffff -> true
Equal64 - noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff 0 -> true
Equal64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff 1 -> false
Equal64 - noncanon 0x6c7386f26fc10000 0x6c7386f26fc0ffff -> false

# --- Equal128 ---

Equal128 - exact 1.0 1.00 -> true
Equal128 - exact 1 1.000000000000000000000000000000001 -> false

Equal128 - exact -1 1 -> false

Equal128 - underflow 1E-6176 1E-6176 -> true
Equal128 - underflow 1E-6176 2E-6176 -> false

Equal128 - zero 0 -0 -> true
Equal128 - zero 0E+6111 -0E-6176 -> true
Equal128 - zero 0 1E-6176 -> false

Equal128 - inf Infinity Infinity -> true
Equal128 - inf Infinity -Infinity -> false

Equal128 - nan NaN NaN -> false
Equal128 - nan sNaN sNaN -> false
Equal128 - nan NaN 1 -> false
Equal128 - nan 0x7c000000000000010000000000000000 0x7c000000000000010000000000000000 -> false

Equal128 - noncanon 0x3041ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 0 -> true
Equal128 - noncanon 0x6c100000000000000000000000000000 -0 -> true
Equal128 - noncanon 0xb047ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 0 -> true
Equal128 - noncanon 0x3041ffffffffffffffffffffffffffff 1 -> false

# --- Less64 ---

Less64 - exact 1 2 -> true

Less64 - zero 0E+369 0E-398 -> false

Less64 - inf 9.999999999999999E+384 Infinity -> true
Less64 - inf Infinity Infinity -> false

Less64 - nan 1 NaN -> false

Less64 - nan sNaN Infinity -> false
Less64 - nan -Infinity -NaN -> false

Less64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff 0 -> false
Less64 - noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff 1E-398 -> true

# --- Compare64 ---

Compare64 - exact 1 2 -> -1 true
Compare64 - exact 2 1 -> 1 true
Compare64 - exact 1.0 1 -> 0 true
Compare64 - exact -1 -2 -> 1 true
Compare64 - exact 1E+2 100 -> 0 true
Compare64 - exact 9.999999999999999E+384 1E+369 -> 1 true

Compare64 - underflow -1E-398 1E-398 -> -1 true
Compare64 - underflow 1E-398 0 -> 1 true
Compare64 - underflow 1E-398 1E-398 -> 0 true

Compare64 - zero -0 0 -> 0 true
Compare64 - zero 0 0.00 -> 0 true
Compare64 - zero 0 -1E-398 -> 1 true
Compare64 - zero -0 0E+369 -> 0 true

Compare64 - inf -Infinity Infinity -> -1 true

Compare64 - inf Infinity Infinity -> 0 true
Compare64 - inf -Infinity -9.999999999999999E+384 -> -1 true

Compare64 - nan 1 NaN -> 0 false
Compare64 - nan NaN NaN -> 0 false
Compare64 - nan sNaN 1 -> 0 false
Compare64 - nan Infinity -NaN -> 0 false
Compare64 - nan 0x7c00000000000001 1 -> 0 false

Compare64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff 0 -> 0 true
Compare64 - noncanon 0x6c77ffffffffffff 1 -> -1 true
Compare64 - noncanon 0xec9fffffffffffff 0 -> 0 true
Compare64 - noncanon 1 0x6c7386f26fc10000 -> 1 true

# --- Compare128 ---

Compare128 - nan 1 NaN -> 0 false

Compare128 - nan NaN NaN -> 0 false

Compare128 - noncanon 0x3041ed09bead87c0378d8e6400000000 0 -> 0 true
Compare128 - noncanon 0x6c100000000000000000000000000000 1 -> -1 true
